notes: Phobos Agriculture vessels, small size: the Verdemorrow Groundwork R3 water reservoir and E2 nutrient hopper (Framework bulk vessels; the R4, R5, E3 and E4 scale through the ladder). The W2 irrigation supply is not here: its 20 kg is the rack reservoir the crop model is written for. Changing a capacity or dry mass leaves existing reservoirs Protected until accepted. Record: docs/agriculture-bulk-storage.md.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkR3.notes: R3: 120 kg of water in a 25 kg housing, 3 x 3. Retired in Agriculture 0.31.0: saved reservoirs convert to Framework's S3 to S5 silos on load, and these ratings are what the conversion reads from them.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkE2.notes: E2 nutrient hopper: 10 kg of formulated dry crop nutrients in a 15 kg housing, 2 x 2; the E3 and E4 scale through the ladder. Damage isolates the contents in a catch chamber; nothing leaks.
